    Home/Weight loss

    Peptides for weight loss, compared with the approved shots.

    Peptide Chooser editorial team. Checked 30 Oct 2026.

    Every claim links to its source.

    Two weekly shots are FDA approved for weight management, semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound), both on prescription. Online clinics also sell compounded copies, cheaper and not checked by the FDA batch by batch.

    Compare the options

    Is it legal today?

    For losing weight with medical help: the two approved weekly shots, what they cost, and the copies sold online.

    • Semaglutide (Wegovy) · weekly shot for weight lossFDA approvedon prescription

      A weekly shot on prescription, for obesity or overweight with a health problem. It cuts appetite.

      A weekly shot that cuts appetite; about 15 % body weight lost on average in trials. 1

    Retatrutide is still in trials and sold only by research-use shops. Below: what each option costs at the clinics we track, and which clinics have an FDA warning letter.

    FDA status of the peptides on this page, each with its source.

    PeptideStatusWhat that means
